title: Optimize LDBC Q14 weightedpaths expression-key indexed probe

steps.step: Continue from BENCHPROD-109 where full test-data Q14 profiler isolated the active bottleneck to weightedpaths
Add optional Q14 message indexes to the profiler harness and verify indexes alone do not solve the weightedpaths timeout
Teach join planning to use indexed right-table probes when the left join key is an expression such as e[1]
Preserve join projection pushdown and keyed probe decode safety for corrupted unused-column regressions
Add focused regression coverage for p.creator_id = e[1] indexed expression probes
Run Rust regression tests and release build
Re-run prefix40 and full test-data Q14 profiler with indexes enabled
Record evidence without claiming full native LDBC pass

result.current_frontier: Q14 weightedpaths profiler stage is no longer timing out on full test-data for the target pair. This remains targeted profiler evidence, not a full official/native LDBC workload pass.

remaining_blockers: Full native LDBC workload has not been reclassified as passed by this task.
Profiler success covers the Q14 target pair and staged query shape, not the full LDBC operation mix.
The LDBC PostgreSQL implementation command-mode update-query coverage remains unproven from earlier runs.
Native memtier remains blocked by missing real memtier_benchmark tooling.
next_task: BENCHPROD-111 candidate: run the native LDBC smoke with Q14 enabled after the weightedpaths fix and separate any remaining workload-driver blockers from database execution blockers.
